description: This file contains C source code implementing logic for breaking and merging file pairs in a diffing context, including functions to decide whether to break a file pair based on their differences, and handling broken pairs for purposes such as rename detection in version control systems.

methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair, used during cleanup after breaking pairs.

methods.description: Processes the current diff queue to merge back broken pairs that can be combined, refining the diff results.
